findings_and_connected_questions.title: Surgery POST omits the context claim required by the authoritative treatment decision
findings_and_connected_questions.trace: For a nonself patient, the web surgery form and POST contain procedure, optional projectile, soap and action ID but always send None for both context reference and membership revision. The reducer maps that to no contextual claim. If the patient has any valid current contextual membership under its collection predicate, the decision returns Unavailable on a missing claim before checking the target preference or emergency rule. The same-settlement branch establishes co-presence independently; assuming the observed-character/location and other UI requirements hold, the dialog can be reached, yet the submitted treatment is rejected. The route logs the error and redirects without distinguishing it from success.
findings_and_connected_questions.conditions: Assumes a living authorized nonself actor/patient, a qualifying patient context membership, matching view and location, and all other admission conditions. Existence or frequency of this live state and practical player impact were not observed. Self treatment remains a separate allowed path; no unsupported authorization-bypass or data disclosure claim.
findings_and_connected_questions.future_repair_direction: Determine correct authorized contextual contact reference and membership revision at the actual presentation/action boundary; propagate them with the procedure and preserve exact stale-claim, consent, emergency, retry receipt and final authority checks. If a context cannot be represented, show an explicit unavailable state instead of submitting a guaranteed missing claim.

nonfindings.text: Surgery required patient injury, projectile, inventory, actor injury and item definition reads fail with explicit medical-unavailable output. Patient lookup and contextual query can still collapse error separately; do not conflate paths.
Surgery reducer validates actor authority, togetherness, living patients, action ID and contextual decision; route and reducer deficiencies do not establish unauthorized treatment.
Stop-preparation reducer looks up actual administration patient and invokes relationship/authority checks; path patient ID being used for redirect alone is not itself an authorization bypass.

Standard medication uses self as patient, typed current profile, route, standard dose and no arbitrary browser dosage; unchecked/unknown-profile failures are distinct historical 059 q511 and q512 typed-reason issues.
Empty liquidation selections are explicitly rejected by reducer; do not allege malformed selection sells all assets. Individual deposit/withdraw calls remain independently error-obscured.

The active selector intentionally excludes stopped, out-of-window and unknown-profile records. Patient clock absence on stop falls back to administered_at in the reducer; whether such missing clock is reachable or fallback represents an acceptable chronology is open and was already noted by prior /root/hair_ops.

No assumption that a random missing/malformed backend administration is reachable: normal administration requires a positive checked dose before persisting; other writers/storage require separate proof.
